name: @code-ministry/agentenv
description: Virtual environments for AI agents - switchable bundles of skills, instructions, MCP servers, subagents and slash commands, applied across any AI coding harness

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:playwright && npm run typecheck:ui
scripts.test:ui: vitest run test/ui-contract.test.ts test/ui-build.test.ts test/ui-server.test.ts test/ui-command.test.ts
scripts.test:ui:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:migration: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null vitest run test/legacy-state.test.ts test/migration-state.test.ts test/migration.test.ts test/migration-command.test.ts test/migration.subprocess-kill.test.ts
scripts.test:live: vitest run test/adapter.claude.live.test.ts test/adapter.codex.live.test.ts test/adapter.opencode.live.test.ts test/adapter.pi.live.test.ts test/adapter.cursor.live.test.ts
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('agentenv is distributed from GitHub only (see docs/RELEASE.md). npm publish is not supported: the npm name is a parked placeholder.'); process.exit(1)"
